purpose: Representative quality and reliability evaluation for the local Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice pipeline.

cases.title: Dialogue separated from narrator attribution
cases.source_text: “Is anyone there?” Mira asked. “I brought the lantern!”

normalization_decisions.decision: Outer dialogue quotation marks are structural and are not spoken.

cases.title: Short line followed by a long nested sentence

cases.title: Names and foreign words with explicit lexicon notes
cases.source_text: Anaïs met Siobhán beside the café in Łódź and thanked her with a quiet merci.

normalization_decisions.decision: Use the episode lexicon; preserve the display spelling.
Use the episode lexicon; preserve the display spelling.

cases.title: Dates, time, currency, ordinals, abbreviations, and units
cases.source_text: On July 31, 2026, at 9:05 a.m., Dr. Rivera paid $1,234.50 for the 3rd 5 km sensor test. Battery output rose by 12.5% to 48 V.

normalization_decisions.decision: The written month removes numeric date ambiguity.
Expand km and V in context.

expected_segments.display_text: On July 31, 2026, at 9:05 a.m., Dr. Rivera paid $1,234.50 for the 3rd 5 km sensor test.
expected_segments.spoken_text: On July thirty-first, twenty twenty-six, at nine oh five a.m., Doctor Rivera paid one thousand two hundred thirty-four dollars and fifty cents for the third five kilometer sensor test.

expected_segments.display_text: Battery output rose by 12.5% to 48 V.
expected_segments.spoken_text: Battery output rose by twelve point five percent to forty-eight volts.

cases.title: Prosodic punctuation without literal formatting speech
cases.source_text: Wait—listen... not to the clock, but to the space between its ticks; there—did you hear it?

expected_segments.display_text: Wait—listen... not to the clock, but to the space between its ticks; there—did you hear it?
expected_segments.spoken_text: Wait—listen... not to the clock, but to the space between its ticks; there—did you hear it?

cases.title: Technical names, versions, flags, paths, and initialisms
cases.source_text: JaroMail syncs IMAP over TLS 1.3 and stores one file per message in Maildir. To inspect issue qtw-48r, run `bd show qtw-48r`—not `bd --help`—from the project root.

normalization_decisions.decision: Use project lexicon entries for JaroMail, IMAP, TLS, and Maildir.
Remove code formatting, preserve command tokens, and speak option dashes.

expected_segments.display_text: JaroMail syncs IMAP over TLS 1.3 and stores one file per message in Maildir.
expected_segments.spoken_text: Jaro Mail syncs eye-map over T L S one point three and stores one file per message in Maildir.

expected_segments.display_text: To inspect issue qtw-48r, run `bd show qtw-48r`—not `bd --help`—from the project root.
expected_segments.spoken_text: To inspect issue Q T W forty-eight R, run B D show Q T W forty-eight R—not B D dash dash help—from the project root.
